# Unit 4 Week 8 pack

> Resource packaged with textbook edition 0.48 (14 October 2026): 50 draft chapters across Units 1–4; all four editorial coverage maps are available. Independent review and learner evidence remain pending. Original authoring dates below are provenance, not new sign-off; teacher keys are separate but not access-protected.

Run Python 3 unit4-crypto-model.py offline with the standard library. Caesar is intentionally insecure and SHA-256 is a fingerprint, not encryption, authentication or password storage. No network requests, real keys, school systems or student records. Certificate facts and TLS cards are teaching abstractions; no actual TLS service is implemented. Teacher answers are not access-protected. Independent review and learner evidence remain pending.
